definition: what I believe about God and the church, and how I hold it

settled:
I hold it as a conclusion I reasoned my way to, not as a relationship I feel.

The reasoning has carried the faith the whole time, including the years the feeling was still running.

Feeling never got a vote on the verdict.

Most members of my church rest their faith on feeling. They pray and feel that it is true. That route is shut to me, so I took the one that was open and approached my faith like everything else in my life, as an object of reason.
